thread:
Maya: Quick heads-up — Acme visitor (Nina) arriving ~5pm with an oversized crate and a stroller. Could someone meet at the lobby? :wave: 
Reception-Bot: Courier scheduled for 16:40, delivery to lobby. Package size flagged: oversized. 
Alex: I can grab the crate when it arrives and wheel it into the staging room. Where should we badge the visitor? 
Maya: We'll need a temporary guest badge + door access for 2 hours. Front desk printer is a bit flaky today (keeps doing a double-feed). 
Priya: Ugh the badge printer jam again? Last time it was the roller. Can you try the manual feed on the right side? 
Reception-Bot: Badge printer status: warning (paper feed). Maintenance ticket #1129 opened. ETA tech: 2 hours. 
Juan: If printer is down I can print a handwritten badge and seal in clear sleeve. Not ideal but works. 
Sam: I'll be around the lobby at 4:55 to greet Nina and keep the stroller safe. 
Maya: Thank you! Also the crate has 'Fragile - Glass' on it. Please tag as fragile and leave on the padded cart. 
Alex: Got it. I'll bring the padded cart. Anyone know if there's available hotdesk near the demo room? Nina might need a quick table. 
Priya: Hotdesk 7 (near demo room) is free after 5:15. I just left. 
Juan: I'll bring extra markers + clear sleeves. If printer hiccups we can write name + company and stick a QR sticker. 
Reception-Bot: Reminder: visitor policy requires ID at check-in for external guests. Please have Nina ready. 
Maya: FYI — stroller fold fits through service elevator but crate will need the freight elevator on the east side. I'll coordinate with security. 
Alex: Noted. Security told me they can escort for the freight lift. 
Sam: If anyone needs help carrying the crate, ping me. I can do stairs if needed. :muscle: 
Priya: Also leaving a small post-it on the crate that says 'Hold near staging — do not stack' to avoid accidental stacking. 
Maya: Perfect. Thanks, team. I'll DM Nina the lobby pin and ask for ID photo upload beforehand to speed check-in. 
Reception-Bot: Logged actions: manual badge fallback approved, padded cart reserved, freight elevator escort scheduled. 
Juan: Quick Q — where to put the stroller while crate is in staging? 
Maya: Leave stroller in the visitor alcove by the glass wall. I'll reserve a seat on the couch for Nina. 
Alex: All set here. See you at 4:40 for pickup. 
Sam: See you then. :thumbsup:
